items.text: For a change under plugins/: /plugin-release-review completed on the final head (evidence: its checklist status), or "not a plugin change"

Eval numbers (PR body or docs/audits/, never the README), test counts, timings, and Compatibility dates re-measured in this branch when the skill description, evals, or scripts changed; CHANGELOG matches what ships
The repo-auditor subagent returned VERDICT: PASS on the final head SHA before the PR was opened, and again after any later push (evidence: head SHA, verdict line, check rows passed / N/A)
items.verify: h=$(gh pr list --state merged --head "$CHECKLIST_SUBJECT" --json headRefOid -q '.[0].headRefOid' 2>/dev/null); test -n "$h" || h=$(git rev-parse HEAD); f=.claude/state/audits/$h.json; test -f "$f" || { echo "no repo-auditor record for $h"; exit 1; }; jq -e --arg h "$h" '.head == $h and .verdict == "PASS"' "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "repo-auditor verdict for $h is not PASS"; exit 1; }

items.text: PR merged: GitHub reports the authorized head SHA as merged (evidence: PR number, merge commit SHA)
CI and Tag plugin versions are green on the merge commit in main (evidence: run ids and conclusions)
Every plugin version on main has its <id>--vX.Y.Z tag on origin (created only by the Tag plugin versions workflow)
items.verify: for m in plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do [ -f "$m" ] || continue; t=$(jq -r "\"\\(.name)--v\\(.version)\"" "$m"); git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$t" >/dev/null || { echo "missing remote tag $t"; exit 1; }; done

items.text: The feature branch is deleted locally and on origin
items.verify: test -n "$CHECKLIST_SUBJECT" || { echo "no branch recorded"; exit 1; }; if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$CHECKLIST_SUBJECT"; then echo "local branch $CHECKLIST_SUBJECT still exists"; exit 1; fi; git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "refs/heads/$CHECKLIST_SUBJECT" >/dev/null; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || { echo "origin still has $CHECKLIST_SUBJECT (or is unreachable: $rc)"; exit 1; }

items.text: On main, and local main equals origin/main after fetch --prune
items.verify: git fetch --prune --quiet origin && [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ] && [ "$(git rev-parse main)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo "not on main, or main differs from origin/main"; exit 1; }

items.text: Working tree clean and the repo gate passes on main
items.verify: [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { git status --short; exit 1; }; make -s validate
